response.sql: SELECT sites.entrystat, AVG(scanenvironment.ambictemp) as avg_ambient_temperature, AVG(scanenvironment.imgcount) as avg_img_count, AVG(scanenvironment.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(imgcount) FROM scanenvironment INNER JOIN sites ON scanenvironment.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry) as img_count_diff FROM scanenvironment INNER JOIN sites ON scanenvironment.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry GROUP BY sites.entrystat
